description: UX quality checklist for QA verification step. Hard gate — missing items cause fail, not warning.

checks.check: Every entity has a DELETE handler in server.js AND a delete button with confirmation in app.js.
Write operations (POST/PUT/DELETE) trigger user-visible feedback (toast, alert, status message).
List views show empty state text when no data exists, with action button to create first item.
Forms validate required fields before submission with inline error display.
Async data fetches show loading indicator (spinner, skeleton, or text).
Multi-module app has persistent navigation with all modules listed and active state.
Frontend implements ALL modules defined in spec, not just the first one.
checks.method: count modules in spec vs rendered routes/views in app.js

checks.check: Every user-controlled string interpolated into HTML (innerHTML/outerHTML/insertAdjacentHTML/template literals) passes through escapeHtml(). Specifically: showConfirmDialog message, ticket comments, customer names in delete dialogs, entity names rendered in modals.
checks.verify_instructions: Read app.js and enumerate every innerHTML/outerHTML/insertAdjacentHTML assignment. For each, list the interpolated variables and confirm they either come from constant strings OR pass through escapeHtml(). Manual read is more reliable than regex — do NOT rely solely on grep.
checks.note: FAIL if any raw ${userValue} appears in innerHTML-family assignment without escapeHtml wrapper. This is a stored XSS vector.

checks.check: Status/priority/type badge class names use whitelist lookup (const STATUS_CLASS = {...}), not raw interpolation of user-controlled enum values into class attributes.
checks.verify_instructions: Read app.js. Find every class attribute interpolation and every classList.add() call. Confirm the value comes from a static whitelist map keyed by the user value, not the raw value itself.
checks.note: WARN if class attributes or classList.add calls use raw status/priority/type. CSS class injection can load unintended stylesheets or trigger CSS-based data exfil.

checks.check: PUT/POST endpoints validate required fields and enum values. DELETE returns 404 for missing rows, 204 on success.
checks.verify_instructions: Read server.js. For EACH POST/PUT handler: confirm it checks required fields non-empty and returns 400 on failure. For EACH DELETE handler: confirm it checks existence and returns 404 (or 204 on success). For enum fields from the spec (e.g. ticket status/priority if defined), confirm the handler whitelists against the enum.
checks.note: Server.js must reject blank required fields and return 404 on missing delete targets. Enums derived from spec, not hardcoded.

checks.check: qa_report.json must not contradict itself. If semantic_checks marks AC-N as 'warning', acceptance_test_results MUST NOT mark the same AC-N as PASS without explanation.
checks.method: cross-reference check_id status with acceptance_test_results details.
